_note: Researched 2026-11-21 from scholarship news and listing sites (not official notices). Amounts, limits and deadlines change every year: always verify on the official portal before applying. Never show amounts as guaranteed.

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships
scholarships.for: Top scorers in the Class 12 board exam who join a regular college degree
scholarships.amountNote: About ₹12,000 a year for the first 3 years, more for later years of professional courses (as reported)
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Top percentile of your board's Class 12 results; family income limit applies

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
scholarships.for: Girls in the first year of an AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma (e.g. engineering)
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Family income up to ₹8 lakh a year; at most two girls per family

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Government of India, via your state
scholarships.for: OBC, EBC and DNT students in Class 11 onwards
scholarships.amountNote: ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 a year depending on the course (as reported)
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year in most states; some states use a lower limit

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC / ST students
scholarships.provider: Government of India, via your state
scholarships.for: SC and ST students from Class 11 onwards
scholarships.amountNote: Covers fees and a maintenance allowance; amounts set by each state
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Income limits and amounts depend on your state

scholarships.name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS Scholarship
scholarships.for: Students whose family faces financial difficulty or a crisis
scholarships.amountNote: ₹30,000 (general degree) or ₹50,000 (professional degree) for undergraduates (as reported)
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year and at least 55% in your last exam

scholarships.name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
scholarships.for: Top Class 12 board performers who study natural or basic sciences at college
scholarships.amountNote: Check the INSPIRE portal for the current amount
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Based on Class 12 board rank; science degree courses only

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: Check the Reliance Foundation portal for the current amount
scholarships.eligibilityNote: Merit and family income based; selection includes an aptitude test
